title: Laredo Arbor Day to Plant 256 Trees at Divine Mercy Park on Nov. 7
excerpt: Keep Laredo Beautiful will plant 256 trees at Divine Mercy Park on Saturday, Nov. 7, from 8:30 to 11 a.m., according to the Laredo Morning Times.
content:
Laredo will mark Arbor Day with the planting of 256 trees at Divine Mercy Park on Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The event runs from 8:30 to 11 a.m., with sign-in beginning at 8 a.m., at Divine Mercy Park, 9748 Diamond Drive, in Laredo.

The organizer is Keep Laredo Beautiful, described in the article as an environmental nonprofit, working with partners. Alongside the tree planting, volunteers will take part in beautification projects throughout the park, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Volunteers could sign up online through a form linked in the original article.
